description: This source file implements the core logic for the 'git shortlog' command, including functions for parsing commit data, grouping, sorting, and outputting summarized logs of commit authors and messages.

methods.name: int compare_by_counter(const void * a1,const void * a2)
methods.description: Comparison function to sort string list items by their usage count in descending order.

methods.name: int compare_by_list(const void * a1,const void * a2)
methods.description: Comparison function to sort string list items lexicographically based on their associated list size.

methods.name: void insert_one_record(struct shortlog * log,const char * ident,const char * oneline)
methods.description: Inserts a single record into the shortlog, either updating the count or appending a message depending on the summary mode.

methods.name: int parse_ident(struct shortlog * log,struct strbuf * out,const char * in)
methods.description: Parses a commit author or committer identification line into a normalized name and email, with optional mapping.

methods.name: void read_from_stdin(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Reads commit author/committer information from standard input to generate shortlog entries.

methods.name: void insert_records_from_trailers(struct shortlog * log,struct strset * dups,struct commit * commit,struct pretty_print_context * ctx,const char * oneline)
methods.description: Processes trailers in commit messages to extract additional author/identification info and insert into shortlog.

methods.name: int shortlog_needs_dedup(const struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Determines if deduplication is necessary based on the current shortlog settings.

methods.name: void insert_records_from_format(struct shortlog * log,struct strset * dups,struct commit * commit,struct pretty_print_context * ctx,const char * oneline)
methods.description: Inserts commit message formats into the shortlog, optionally deduplicating.

methods.name: void shortlog_add_commit(struct shortlog * log,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Processes a commit object, adding relevant author/subject information into the shortlog.

methods.name: void get_from_rev(struct rev_info * rev,struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Iterates through revisions in rev_info, adding each commit to the shortlog.

methods.name: int parse_uint(char const ** arg,int comma,int defval)
methods.description: Parses a numeric argument from command options, handling default values and validation.

methods.name: int parse_wrap_args(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses line-wrap argument options for output formatting.

methods.name: int parse_group_option(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses grouping options for author, committer, trailer, or format fields.

methods.name: void shortlog_init(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Initializes the shortlog structure, including reading mailmap and setting defaults.

methods.name: void shortlog_finish_setup(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Finalizes the shortlog configuration after parsing options, setting up groupings.

methods.name: int cmd_shortlog(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git shortlog' command, handling argument parsing, revision collection, and output.

methods.name: void add_wrapped_shortlog_msg(struct strbuf * sb,const char * s,const struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Adds a wrapped line of text to the output buffer based on formatting rules.

methods.name: void shortlog_output(struct shortlog * log)
methods.description: Outputs the accumulated shortlog entries, sorted and formatted accordingly.
